---
title: "00 — Project Setup"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
required_packages <- c(
  "here", "sf", "dplyr", "tidyr", "purrr", "readr", "stringr",
  "ggplot2", "caret", "sandwich", "lmtest", "car", "pROC",
  "randomForest", "plm", "tibble", "forcats"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !required_packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_packages)
}

invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

dir.create(here::here("data", "processed"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here::here("results", "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(here::here("results", "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

years <- 2017:2023
distance_tags <- c("0_5mi", "1mi", "2mi")
analysis_crs <- 5070
```
